passive.name: Tranquil Blossom
passive.text: CRIT DMG is increased by **30/34.5/39/43.5/48%**. When the equipper lands a hit with a **Basic Attack**, **Special Attack**, or **Aftershock**, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's CRIT DMG by an additional **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**, stacking up to 3 times. The effect lasts for 30s, with each stack's duration calculated separately, and can only be triggered once per use of a skill. With all 3 stacks, the equipper's **Electric DMG** increases by **20/23/26/29/32%**.

passive.name: Sprouting Core
passive.text: Increases CRIT Rate by **15/17/19/21/23%**. When the equipper deals DMG with a **Basic Attack** or **EX Special Attack**, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's **Electric DMG** by **12.5/14.5/16.5/18.5/20%**, up to 2 stacks. Each stack lasts 40s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. Can trigger once per use of a skill. At 2 stacks, the wearer's **Basic Attack** and **Ultimate** DMG ignore **20/23/26/29/32%** of enemy DEF.

passive.name: String & Melody
passive.text: CRIT DMG increases by **50/57.5/65/72.5/80%**. When the equipper enters combat, or activates a **Chain Attack** or **Ultimate**, they gain 1 stack of **Heartstring**. Each stack of **Heartstring** allows the equipper's **Chain Attack** and **Ultimate** to ignore **12.5/14.5/16.5/18.5/20%** of the target's **Fire RES**, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

passive.name: Get Everyone Fired Up
passive.text: When an **EX Special Attack** or **Chain Attack** hits an enemy, the equipper's ATK increases by **6/6.9/7.8/8.7/9.6%** for 8s. While the target is under an Attribute Anomaly, this effect is increased by an additional **6/6.9/7.8/8.7/9.6%**.

passive.name: Knight's Combo
passive.text: Launching a **Dodge Counter** or **Quick Assist** increases the equipper's ATK by **12/13.8/15.6/17.4/19.2%** for 12s.

substatLine: CRIT RATE = CRIT DMG > ATK% > PEN = ATK
skillPriority: Special Attack > Chain Attack > Basic Attack > Dodge > Assist

entries.name: Basic Attack: Penetrating Shock
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Perform up to five slashes ahead, dealing **Electric DMG**. After the 4th attack hits the enemy, repeatedly press or hold Basic Attack to quickly pass through enemies in front up to 5 times.

entries.name: Dodge: Strobe
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Torrent
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Perform a horizontal slash forward, then follow up with a thrust attack, dealing **Electric DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Ground Flash Counter
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Repeatedly slash enemies in front, dealing **Electric DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Cloud Flash
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Repeatedly slash enemies in front, dealing **Electric DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Counter Surge
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Conducting Blow
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Dash forward and unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, dealing **Electric DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Celestial Thunder
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Dash diagonally forward, then unleash a cross slash, dealing **Electric DMG**.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Azure Flash
entries.text:
When Soldier 0 - Anby's attacks hit an enemy, they apply the **Silver Star** mark and charges the target
For every one-third of charge, the enemy receives 1 stack of **White Thunder**, stacking up to 3 times.
When the enemy has **White Thunder**, press Special Attack to activate:
Quickly dash forward, slashing through enemies and dealing multiple hits of **Electric DMG**.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will consume 1 stack of **White Thunder** to trigger an **Aftershock** that deals 1 extra instance of **Electric DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Thunder Smite
entries.text:
When the additional damage from **White Thunder** triggers 3 times on the same enemy:
A lightning strike will fall at the enemy's location, dealing **Electric DMG** to enemies within range.
This DMG is considered **Aftershock** DMG.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt
entries.text:
With enough energy, hold EX Special Attack to activate:
Combines her twin swords and throws them forward for a high-speed slash, dealing massive **Electric DMG**.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge **Silver Star**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Leaping Thunderstrike
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Leap forward, then quickly dive and perform a cross slash, dealing massive **Electric DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Voidstrike
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Perform a powerful series of slashes at a large area in front, followed by a lightning strike, dealing massive **Electric DMG**.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge **Silver Star**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Voltage Gap
entries.text: Soldier 0 - Anby's DMG against enemies with the **Silver Star** mark increases by **25%**. After an enemy is marked with **Silver Star**, the CRIT DMG received from **Aftershock** attacks is further increased by **30%** of Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT DMG.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Voltage Surge
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is a **Stun** or **Support** character:
Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT Rate increases by 10%. When Soldier 0 - Anby is the active character, all squad members' **Aftershock** DMG to enemies with a **Silver Star** mark increases by 25%.

entries.name: Static Charge
entries.text: When Soldier 0 - Anby uses an **EX Special Attack** to hit an enemy, it triggers the additional DMG from **White Thunder** 3 times. This effect does not consume any **White Thunder** stacks.

entries.name: Fail-Safe Protocol
entries.text:
Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT Rate increases by 12%. When she uses her **Ultimate**, she gains 6 stacks of **Thunder's Cry** (max 6 stacks). With **Thunder's Cry**, when using **Special Attack: Azure Flash** to hit an enemy with **White Thunder**, it will consume 1 stack of **Thunder's Cry** instead. Only 1 stack of **Thunder's Cry** will be consumed when a single use of a skill hits multiple enemies, and consuming **Thunder's Cry** will still activate the additional DMG from **White Thunder**.
After activating potential, every 3 stacks of **Thunder's Cry** consumed, the next Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary will be activated faster.

entries.name: Past Glory
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Silver Reverb
entries.text: When hitting an enemy marked with **Silver Star**, Soldier 0 - Anby ignores 12% of the target's **Electric RES**.

entries.name: Director's Cut
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Prequel Protagonist
entries.text: Upon triggering 6 instances of **White Thunder**'s additional DMG, an electromagnetic vortex will be generated, dealing 1,000% of Soldier 0 - Anby's ATK as **Electric DMG** against the target and surrounding enemies. This DMG is considered **Aftershock** DMG.
